title: Uniqueness of bilinear sheafification extension
statement: On a site (C,J), let O be a presheaf of commutative rings, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and α : O → R a locally bijective ring map. Let F,G be presheaves of O-modules, F#,G# their R-module sheafifications, and H a sheaf of R-modules, as in the cited statement dependencies. If two sectionwise R-bilinear families γ,δ : F# × G# → H are both compatible with all restriction maps and agree after precomposition with both module sheafification units, then γ = δ.

source.place: Tag 0GMW, sheafification step in the construction of tensor products

proof.text: The two module units have underlying abelian-group maps toSheafify, which are locally surjective by Mathlib. For any pair of sections x,y, intersect their image covering sieves (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem and GrothendieckTopology.intersection_covering). On every arrow in the intersection choose lifts a,b. Naturality of both families and their equality on unit images show equality of their restrictions. H.isSheaf.isSeparated gives equality of the original values; function and linear-map extensionality conclude.

theorem unique_bilinear_sheafification_extension
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    (O : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w})
    (α : (O ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w} RingCat.{max u v w}) ⟶
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w} RingCat.{max u v w})).obj R).obj)
    [Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J α] [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J α]
    (F G : PresheafOfModules.{max u v w} (O ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w} RingCat.{max u v w}))
    (H : SheafOfModules.{max u v w}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v w} RingCat.{max u v w})).obj R))
    {γ δ : ∀ X : Cᵒᵖ,
      ((sheafification α).obj F).val.obj X →ₗ[R.obj.obj X]
        ((sheafification α).obj G).val.obj X →ₗ[R.obj.obj X] H.val.obj X}
    (hγmap : ∀ {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (x : ((sheafification α).obj F).val.obj X)
      (y : ((sheafification α).obj G).val.obj X),
      γ Y (((sheafification α).obj F).val.map f x)
        (((sheafification α).obj G).val.map f y) = H.val.map f (γ X x y))
    (hδmap : ∀ {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (x : ((sheafification α).obj F).val.obj X)
      (y : ((sheafification α).obj G).val.obj X),
      δ Y (((sheafification α).obj F).val.map f x)
        (((sheafification α).obj G).val.map f y) = H.val.map f (δ X x y))
    (hγ : ∀ (X : Cᵒᵖ) (x : F.obj X) (y : G.obj X),
      γ X (((sheafificationAdjunction α).unit.app F).app X x)
        (((sheafificationAdjunction α).unit.app G).app X y) =
        δ X (((sheafificationAdjunction α).unit.app F).app X x)
          (((sheafificationAdjunction α).unit.app G).app X y)) : γ = δ
